about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: About Me
about.description: I have been developing web services centered on React, Next.js, and TypeScript. In collaborative environments, I standardized quality and builds using Husky, ESLint, Prettier, and Vite, and documented common components with Storybook to improve communication efficiency. For state management, I primarily use MobX and selectively apply Zustand or Context API depending on project needs. With experience in Node.js and Next.js backend development, I have strong understanding between frontend and backend for smooth communication.
